evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic reports completeness and testing problems in long-running web-app development, and describes scaffolding that improves results. This supports caution about one-prompt completeness but does not directly test a Salesforce competitor.

The contemporary report describes ordinary Claude Code operation as interactive and explains how added scaffolding enables greater autonomy. It provides relevant limitations, but its demonstration concerns a compiler rather than CRM construction.

unresolved_gaps: No reproducible single-prompt CRM trial meeting the specified completeness standard was located.
General web-development failures do not establish inability on every possible CRM task.
No agreed acceptance specification defines a fully formed Salesforce competitor.
